FERRY GO ROUND
Dance. Sail. Repeat.
Our last boat party of the year… or maybe not. 😉
On Friday, November 20, take your night onto the Bay. Ferry Go Round sets sail from Oakland’s Jack London Square toward San Francisco for a late-night party with the city lights around you and DJ Brown Buoy behind the decks.
Bollywood anthems. Indo House grooves. Bhangra bangers. All night.
From the glowing Bay Bridge to Oracle Park and the San Francisco skyline, catch breathtaking views between dance-floor moments with your crew.
THE DETAILS
Friday, November 20, 2026
10:30 PM–1:30 AM
Boarding begins: 10:30 PM
Departure & return:
Jack London Square
2 Broadway, Oakland, CA
Return: 1:30 AM on Saturday, November 21.
GET ON BOARD
One boat. Only 150 spots. Lock in your tickets and get your crew on board before they’re gone.
GOOD TO KNOW
• 21+ with valid government-issued photo ID required.
• Arrive early for check-in and allow time for parking.
• All ticket sales are final. No refunds.
• By attending, you consent to photography and video recording for promotional use.
Dance. Sail. Repeat.
